pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal patches with softened vertices and smooth edge gradients. Dark regions on the mid-flank are larger and more uniform, while patches on the lower neck and ventral transition are smaller and more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly continuous topological mesh of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the flank with slight pixel expansion at the intersection nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck. The mane presents as a dense, short-cropped fringe against the out-of-focus background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A clear structural gap in the mane continuity is visible at the junction between the neck and the shoulder (cervicothoracic transition).

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme lateral lighting creates deep shadows in the shoulder and axillary regions, emphasizing the underlying musculoskeletal structure of the forelimb attachment.
